summary: This directory defines the core interfaces and data structures required to interact with AI models. It establishes a standardized contract for chat conversations, message content, and streaming generation requests, serving as the abstraction layer for AI integration.
responsibilities: Define the structure of chat messages and message content
Specify the interface for interacting with AI models
Provide standardized contracts for streaming and text generation responses
relationships: The AI Client interface depends on Chat Message definitions to handle conversation state and message transmission.
Chat Messages utilize Chat Content to represent diverse data types like text, images, or tool results.
The AI Client manages the orchestration of Chat Messages during text generation and streaming operations.
designDecisions: Use of TypeScript interfaces to enforce strict contracts for AI interactions.
Decoupling of AI model implementations through a generalized client interface.
Standardized definition of message types to support polymorphic content.
